title: Curphey Cottage | KEY.co
description_expanded: The kitchen and laundry appliances have been recently upgraded in 2022, ensuring that you have all the modern conveniences you need during your vacation. The open floor plan showcases the award-winning architecture and provides a stunning and spacious living area. Relax and unwind in front of the new smart TV, or gather around the well-equipped kitchen with counter seating. The dining space can comfortably accommodate up to eight people, making it perfect for enjoying meals together or hosting intimate gatherings. All of our properties have internet access. However, we do not and cannot guarantee internet connection or access due to service being provided by an outside third-party vendor, restrictions placed on internet services by personal computers, different connection specifications, and any additional factors that may lead to interruption, failure, or unavailability of internet service. No refunds will be given.
